## The question

[Tabular+dcolumn+mathspec — columns overlapping](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/23531/tabulardcolumnmathspec-columns-overlapping), asked by [Matthew Leingang](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/1402/matthew-leingang) on TeX Stack Exchange (2011-07-19; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)):

> I would like to typeset a table using the `D` column type as described in the [`dcolumn`](http://ctan.org/pkg/dcolumn) package.  When I combine this with `\setmathfont(Digits){Gotham Narrow Light}` I get overlapping columns:
>
> ```latex
> \documentclass{article}
> \pagestyle{empty}
> \usepackage{lipsum}
> \usepackage{dcolumn}
> \newcolumntype{d}[1]{D{.}{.}{#1}}
> \usepackage{mathspec}
> \setmainfont[BoldFont=Gotham Narrow Medium]{Gotham Narrow Book}
> \setmathrm{Gotham Narrow Book}
> \setmathfont(Latin){Gotham Narrow Book}
> % works fine
> %\setmathfont(Digits){Monaco}
> \setmathfont(Digits){Arial}
> % causes column overlapping
> \setmathfont(Digits){Gotham Narrow Light}
>
> \begin{document}
> \lipsum[1]
> \[
> \begin{array}{d{1.3}|d{1.5}|d{1.4}|d{1.4}|d{1.4}}
> 1.500 & 2.75000 & 0.5000 & 0.2500 & 1.2500 \\
> 1.750 & 2.93750 & 0.2500 & 0.0625 & 1.0625 \\
> 1.900 & 2.99000 & 0.1000 & 0.0100 & 1.0100 \\
> 1.990 & 2.99990 & 0.0100 & 0.0001 & 1.0001 \\
> 1.999 & 3.00000 & 0.0010 & 0.0000 & 1.0000 \\
> 2.000 & 1.00000 & 0.0000 & 2.0000 & 3.0000 \\
> 2.001 & 3.00000 & 0.0010 & 0.0000 & 1.0000 \\
> 2.010 & 2.99990 & 0.0100 & 0.0001 & 1.0001 \\
> 2.100 & 2.99000 & 0.1000 & 0.0100 & 1.0100 \\
> 2.250 & 2.93750 & 0.2500 & 0.0625 & 1.0625 \\
> 2.500 & 2.75000 & 0.5000 & 0.2500 & 1.2500 \\
> \end{array}
> \]
> \lipsum[2]
> \end{document}
> ```
>
> ![sample output][q-1]
>
>   [q-1]: RDXyt.png
>
> I've tried with other monospace and proportional fonts and they seem to work fine.  Is something wrong with Gotham?
:::

My best workaround so far is to substitute:

```latex
\setmathfont(Digits)[Numbers={Monospaced}]{Gotham Narrow Light}
```

The side effect is that *all* digits in the entire document are now monospaced.
